enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn over to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Stretch legs. Sleep.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on bathrobe. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Take off bathrobe. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Stand in front of mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Put on watch. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pour milk into glass. Put toast and eggs on plate. Carry plate to table. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Carry plate to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a clinical shift at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital ward. Change into scrubs. Attend handover meeting. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Sanitize hands. Check vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient. Check IV drip. Talk to colleague. Write notes. Use computer. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to ward. Continue rounds. End shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Carry plate to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Carry plate to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Put away broom. Turn off kitchen light.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Press channel button. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink water. Continue watching TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on pajamas. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type on keyboard. Browse websites. Check email. Close laptop. Stand up. Change into pajamas. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Use phone. Put down phone. Turn off light. Close eyes. Sleep.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn over to right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep.
